P6229.corridor_notes: P6229 = the 'Northern Xinjiang' (北疆) half of a 14-project, 4977 km strategic expansion announced 2023-07-08 by Xinjiang autonomous region government + PetroChina (5 northern projects / 2863.5 km / 4.66 billion RMB; 9 southern projects / 2113.5 km / 7.99 billion RMB = P6230). GEM's Wiki links this row to 'Zungharia Basin Rim Gas Pipeline Network' (准噶尔盆地周边天然气管网), consistent with what was found: a Karamay/Xinjiang-Oilfield hub (Jinlong Town + Karamay First Station, FuelSource = Karamay Oil Field) feeding gas 'benefit-the-people' (利民) branch pipelines that fan out to four northern prefectures — Tacheng, Altay, Ili (Yining), and Bortala (Bole) — plus a Karamay-to-Urumqi (Wangjiagou/Toutunhe) trunk, which matches GEM's existing StartLocation='Jinlong Town'/EndLocation='Wangjiagou' pair (both independently corroborated: Jinlong Town via a 2026 valve-well bidding notice at 'Jinlong Town First Station' in Karamay; Wangjiagou via CNPC Xinjiang Oilfield's registered 'Wangjiagou Oil & Gas Storage and Transport Center' in Urumqi's Toutunhe District). Altay and Bortala branches are each being built in two phases/segments (Kelamaili-Fuhai then Fuhai-Fuyun; Jinghe-Alashankou and Bole-Wenquan respectively), which is why their 'start'/'end' fields above span the full multi-phase corridor rather than a single short segment. Individual per-branch lengths as reported (Tacheng ~264-407 km depending on trunk-vs-trunk+branches count; Altay 246 km + 335.7 km; Bortala ~179-198 km combined) do not cleanly sum to the GEM total of 2863.5 km — this program is still under active construction/tendering as of mid-2026 and press figures for the same corridor vary by report date and by whether branch spurs are included.
P6229.researcher_notes: Strong MULTI_BRANCH result: 5 distinct legs sourced, 4 of them (Tacheng, Altay, Ili, Bortala) from official Xinjiang prefecture/autonomous-region government (.gov.cn) sites or Xinhua/state media, plus the Karamay-Wangjiagou trunk independently corroborating GEM's own pre-existing StartLocation/EndLocation. The 2023-07-08 ts.cn announcement article (already GEM's own Status/Proposal ref) is bot-walled (returns a bot-detection JS challenge page, HTTP 200, to both curl and the verifier) and has no Wayback snapshot — its '北疆5个项目/南疆9个项目' figures were confirmed instead via a search-engine cached snippet and independently via chinagas.org.cn / xjdrc.xinjiang.gov.cn coverage of the same figures, so I'm treating the underlying facts as corroborated even though ts.cn itself can't be verified live. No official single-document 'list of 5 named branches' was found; the branch roster here was assembled by cross-referencing prefecture-level progress reports (each explicitly described as part of 南北疆天然气利民管道扩建工程, the parent program) against GEM's own StartLocation/EndLocation and the 2023 north/south split. Karamay-based sources consistently reference TWO similarly-spelled-in-pinyin-but-distinct places: 克拉玛依/Karamay (the city/oilfield) vs 克拉美丽/Kelamaili (a gas field further east/northeast, in Altay-prefecture territory near Fuhai) — do not conflate them when drawing candidate geometry.
P6229.blockers: Could not find a single official document enumerating all 5 branches by name/length/exact endpoint in one place — figures were cross-referenced across multiple prefecture-level progress articles instead. Exact km figure for each branch varies by article/date because these are multi-phase, still-under-construction projects (as of 2026); no branch-by-branch length breakdown that sums cleanly to 2863.5 km was found. The Ili branch's two named sub-branches (Nilka vs Xinyuan) were not separately geocoded with distinct endpoints — only the shared Yining hub and Nilka (as one representative distal point) were sourced with confidence.

P6230.corridor_notes: P6230 = the 'Southern Xinjiang' (南疆) half of the same 2023-07-08 14-project announcement as P6229 (9 southern projects / 2113.5 km / 7.99 billion RMB). GEM's Wiki links this row to 'Tarim Basin Rim Gas Pipeline Network' (塔里木盆地周边天然气管网). IMPORTANT: this program's southern projects appear to have been substantially re-branded/consolidated by 2024 under the name '气化南疆天然气管道工程' (Gasification of Southern Xinjiang), which GEM tracks as a SEPARATE row, P7448 (2108 km, construction, started 2024-03-29) — see duplicate/overlap note in researcher_notes. The branches sourced here are: (1) the 气化南疆 west trunk (Kuqa-Bachu, identical corridor to P7448's west branch — kept here too since it is explicitly the shared backbone P6230's 'Aksu' project component connects to), (2) a Kashgar-prefecture local utility branch reaching Tumushuke City/48th Regiment off the Bachu tie-in point (could not source a verifiable URL for this specific segment — see blockers), and (3) a newly-started (Dec 2025) Hotan-prefecture branch reaching the existing CNPC Hotan gas station via Yecheng/Pishan/Kunyu/Moyu — this is presumably one of the 9 original 'southern projects' still being built out as of this research date (2026-07-30). Other likely southern projects (Kizilsu/克州, additional Bazhou/巴州 segments) were not individually named/sourced.
P6230.researcher_notes: STRONG SUSPECTED OVERLAP WITH P7448 — flagging for human adjudication rather than setting duplicate_of unilaterally: P6230 ('9 branches', 2113.5 km, proposed, sourced only to the 2023-07 announcement, no RouteType/route) and P7448 ('气化南疆', 2108 km, construction since 2024-03, much more richly documented — capacity, fuel source, an explicit note about the corridor becoming an 'O-shaped' ring) both (a) are explicitly described in official sources as components of the SAME parent program (南北疆天然气利民管道扩建工程), (b) cover the same southern-Xinjiang / Tarim-basin-rim geography (Kashgar/Aksu/Bazhou/Hotan), and (c) have near-identical total lengths (2113.5 vs 2108 km). It looks very likely that the 2023-announced '9 southern projects' were consolidated/rebranded into the 气化南疆 program by the time construction started in 2024, i.e. P6230 may be an earlier, less-developed snapshot of what P7448 now represents in more detail — but I could not find a document that explicitly equates the two, and a Kashgar-prefecture and Hotan-prefecture branch (found here) are not mentioned in any of the 气化南疆-specific sourcing for P7448, so P6230's scope may be somewhat broader than P7448's. Recommend a human decide whether to retire/merge P6230 into P7448 or keep both with a cross-reference note.
P6230.blockers: Could not source a verifiable URL for the Kashgar-prefecture branch's exact endpoints (巴楚县段/四十八团段, 149.928 km per a toutiao/tender-aggregator report) — toutiao, jianyu360, dlztb, and bidcenter pages all returned 200 but rendered no extractable body text to the verifier (likely JS-rendered/bot-gated tender portals); kept the claim with empty refs per instructions. Did not find individually-named/sourced branches for the remaining ~5-6 of the original '9 southern projects' (e.g. Kizilsu/克州) within the research budget. See researcher_notes for the P6230/P7448 overlap question, which a human should resolve before drawing final route geometry for either row (drawing both independently risks double-digitizing the same physical pipe).

P7448.corridor_notes: 气化南疆天然气管道工程 (Gasification of Southern Xinjiang) is explicitly described (GEM's own ResearcherNotes, corroborated by xinjiang.gov.cn) as turning the existing 'C'-shaped southern-Xinjiang gas network into an 'O'-shaped closed ring around the Tarim Basin, connecting Kashgar, Aksu, and Bazhou (巴州) prefectures — 9 counties/cities total, raising daily peak supply from 27 to 58 million m3. Total length 2108 km, built in 3 batches; Batch 1 (2024, ~616-1126 km depending on source/date) comprises the two named trunks sourced here: a WEST line from Kuqa (near the Kela-Keshen gas field, Tarim Oilfield's main gas source, matching GEM's FuelSource) through Xinhe/Wensu/Alar/Aksu/Kalping to Bachu County, and an EAST line from Lunnan Town (on the existing West-East Gas Pipeline, Luntai County) to Korla's Shangku industrial park. A 2025-03-10 groundbreaking ceremony for '英买力至三岔' (west) + '轮南至上库工业园区' (east) — combined 510 km — was held simultaneously in Kashgar and Aksu, described as the SAME two lines. Batches 2-3 (reaching Kashgar/Hotan further out, closing the ring) are being built by prefecture-level projects that GEM tracks separately as P6230 (see that row's researcher_notes for a flagged overlap concern). OSM carries actual traced geometry for part of the east trunk — see map_or_vector.

map_or_vector.desc: Overpass pull (man_made=pipeline, substance=gas, area=Xinjiang, incl. lifecycle tags) — 25 stitched features from 56 OSM ways, ODbL-licensed. Two features are directly relevant to P7448's east trunk: one named '气化南疆天然气管道工程上库燃料气复线' (Gasification-of-Southern-Xinjiang pipeline, Shangku fuel-gas duplicate line — coords 85.171,41.773 to 85.369,41.923) and one named '塔里木油田轮南-库尔勒输气线' (Tarim Oilfield Lunnan-Korla gas transmission line — coords 84.221,41.468 to 85.623,41.872, closely matching the sourced Lunnan-Shangku/Korla trunk endpoints above). Both are tagged lifecycle=operating in OSM, which is ahead of GEM's 'construction' status for this row — worth a status cross-check. No OSM geometry was found for the west trunk (Kuqa-Bachu) or for either P6229 or P6230's branches.

P7448.researcher_notes: Solid MULTI_BRANCH result for Batch 1 (the only fully-named, fully-sourced batch): 2 named trunk lines, each corroborated by 2+ independent sources (aksxw.com regional news + xj.chinadaily.com.cn), with the east trunk further corroborated by matching OSM-traced geometry (see map_or_vector) — a strong signal this segment is either built or far enough along to be surveyable. GEM's own capacity figure (11.3 bcm/y) and FuelSource (Kela-Keshen gas field) line up with the west trunk's Kuqa/Tarim-Oilfield origin. See P6230's researcher_notes for a flagged concern that P6230 and P7448 may substantially represent the same physical southern-Xinjiang ring program at different stages of development/documentation — a human should adjudicate before finalizing route geometry for both.
P7448.blockers: Batches 2 and 3 (the remainder of the ring closing through Kashgar/Hotan, ~1000+ km) were not distinctly sourced under the '气化南疆' name itself — the Hotan and Kashgar prefecture-level projects found (and staged under P6230) may or may not be formally part of 'Batch 2/3' of this specific named project; no document explicitly assigns them a batch number. No coordinates for the industrial-park-level Shangku endpoint were found (only city-level Korla); the OSM trace's endpoint is a closer proxy.
